# IslandHop

> IslandHop is the Caribbean's all-in-one on-demand delivery and logistics platform — food delivery, pharmacy, groceries, courier, taxi, and car rental in one premium app, built for Trinidad & Tobago and the wider Caribbean.

## Services

- [Food Delivery](https://islandhopapp.com/restaurants): Order from local restaurants for fast Caribbean cuisine delivery.
- [Car Rentals](https://islandhopapp.com/car-rentals): Airport and city car rental services across the islands.
- [Pricing](https://islandhopapp.com/pricing): Delivery fees, service fees, and partner subscription tiers.

## Partners & Drivers

- [Become a Partner](https://islandhopapp.com/partner): Restaurants, pharmacies, grocery stores, and suppliers can join the network. Standard (free, 15% commission), Pro (TT$800/mo, 10%), and Premium (TT$1,600/mo, 5%) tiers.
- [Drive with Us](https://islandhopapp.com/driver-onboarding): Earn as a driver with Standard, Pro (TT$700/mo), and Premium (TT$1,400/mo) subscription tiers.
- [Promote & Earn](https://islandhopapp.com/promote): Share a referral QR code and earn for every business onboarded.
